_note: Transcribed from section 4 of the 9093 syllabus for 2024, 2025 and 2026. The syllabus states each question part's marks and the assessment objectives it assesses, which is the answer architecture for this subject, so it is recorded here. Every quote is checked against its page before the facts are built.

notes.fact: Question 1(a): a directed writing response of 150-200 words to a 550-750 word text, 10 marks, assessing AO1 and AO2. Question 1(b): comparison of the form, structure and language of that response with the original, 15 marks, assessing AO1 and AO3.
quotes: (a) directed writing task in response to a text (10 marks)

notes.fact: Question 2: text analysis of one unseen 550-750 word text, commenting on form, structure and language, 25 marks, assessing AO1 and AO3.
Question 1(a): a short text of no more than 400 words to a prompt, 15 marks, assessing AO2. Question 1(b): a reflective commentary on how that text fulfils the brief, 10 marks, assessing AO3.
quotes: (a) writing a short text in response to a prompt (15 marks)

notes.fact: Extended writing: one of three questions, one per category - imaginative/descriptive, discursive/argumentative, review/critical. 25 marks.
quotes: Candidates choose to answer one out of three questions.
